svg.title: THE WORLD IS OURS — Zolboo
svg.desc: Zolboo, full-stack developer from Mongolia. TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase. A night landscape: a snow-capped volcano stands before a large pale moon, a pagoda and pines line the far shore, ripples spread across the lake, and a blossoming sakura leans in from the right, shedding petals. 世界は我らのもの — THE WORLD IS OURS.
